name: NGC 4680, host of SN 1997bp (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4680, a spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: n4680-hubble
story: NGC 4680's spiral arms are faint and loosely defined, so it is sometimes classed as a lenticular galaxy instead. In 1997 it hosted a supernova, SN 1997bp, spotted by an amateur astronomer.

claims.text: NGC 4680 is a spiral galaxy, sometimes classified as lenticular
Its spiral arms are not clearly defined
NGC 4680 hosted SN 1997bp in 1997, identified by amateur astronomer Robert Evans
N4680 is a spiral-galaxy target of program 15640 (Cepheid/SN Ia host calibration)
